summary: Open backlog revisions against evolved approved inputs and scaffold fresh review rounds while preserving historical approvals and coverage gates. Opening a revision judges criterion coverage against the BA universe of the last committed backlog approval, in which a topic registry created since then holds no ids, while Delivery still refuses an approved backlog that misses a criterion approved after it. An unchanged approved Story keeps a superseded Solution Design or System Architecture note it cited while that note was approved or accepted.
